title: Leap year detection
task_text: Given a positive integer year, determine whether it is a leap year. A year is leap if it is divisible by 4, except years divisible by 100 and not divisible by 400.
expected_behavior: Print "leap" for leap years and "normal" for non-leap years.

title: Purchase discount calculation
task_text: Write a program that calculates the final purchase price with a discount: 3% if the purchase amount is greater than 500 UAH, and 5% if the amount is greater than 1000 UAH.
expected_behavior: For an input amount, print the final amount after applying the correct discount tier.

title: Count word occurrences
task_text: Given a text and a user-provided word, determine how many times the word occurs in the text.
expected_behavior: Print the number of occurrences of the target word in the text.

title: Find maximum and reverse list
task_text: Given a list of N integer elements entered from the keyboard, find the maximum element and print the list in reverse order.
expected_behavior: Print the maximum value and the reversed list.
